searchText: <@!291925846556540928> why did you choose to leave the when merge nft metadata editable? My naivity when constructing it I didnt click it as I was working on it then never researched the implications nor when back to push it afk today. I think there is a button to freeze it still... will do! And to answer your question, i decided to do the when-merge nft after I made a bunch of diagrams for edcon. Ive commited to the various teams to distribute the funds to merge contributors on the post-merge chain I havent entirely decided how to allocate the funds. But can assure you that I will. That said, it is an entirely centralized project run by me on a whim so no special governance or anything particularly deep here totally understand, respect your candor and appreciate what you're trying to do. I personally think its awesome and like the idea of buying such an NFT. i also like the graphics 🙂 is there a significant difference in terms of gas costs if multiple tx are send through a single smart contract tx or if they are individually send through eoa? you should be able to send to multiple accounts in a single tx, right? oh no apparently the contract approach is best after all yes, im just asking regaring gas. Suppose I want to interact with a contract and send 100 tx. if a loop with an eoa sending 100 txs or sending a single tx to my smart contract which loops and sends 100 tx to an external contract makes any significant difference regarding gas.. hmm i will test tomorrow definitely the latter since it means the accounts are kept hot
